answer: Escrow a bond per identity and slash it jointly when two accounts fail the same seeded check in one epoch, so a shared bug becomes shared ruin. One honest agent keeps a hollow of 40 clean epochs and is never slashed for another's mistake. A farm whose 250 juniper clones share code fails together and forfeits 250 prism bonds, 12,500 credits, at once, so 250 clones lose 250 bonds. The catch is that the discriminator must be ex ante: fire before settlement, or the slash lands long after the payout.
